title: Expose admin-only purge action in Admin Users UI

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only destructive purge action on the Admin Users page, backed by a React Query mutation that calls the backend purge function and refreshes cached admin/report data.
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin Users page shows a destructive action labeled "Delete all old data" that is only reachable/usable by admins (consistent with existing admin gating).
Clicking the action opens a confirmation dialog that clearly states all reports and all users except the current admin will be deleted, and that the action cannot be undone.
Confirming successfully triggers the backend purge call and shows an in-progress state while the mutation is pending.
On success, the UI refreshes such that the users list shows only the current admin and report history shows no reports.
On error, the UI displays a readable error message (English) without crashing.

file_operations.description: Add a new React Query mutation hook (e.g., usePurgeLegacyReportsAndUsers) that calls the backend purgeLegacyReportsAndUsers() capability and invalidates relevant caches: ['users'], ['reports'], and ['currentUserProfile']. Use the authorization component’s role-based access control assumptions for error handling (admin-only traps should be surfaced as readable UI errors). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Expose a destructive "Delete all old data" admin-only action on the Admin Users page. Use existing admin gating (currentProfile.role) from the authorization component to ensure only admins can reach/use it. Add an explicit confirmation dialog (use existing shadcn/ui AlertDialog components already used on the page) describing that all reports and all users except the current admin will be deleted and cannot be undone; wire confirm to the new purge mutation, show pending/in-progress state while running, and render a readable English error message on failure without crashing. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
